nodes.label: Wrong credentials show Invalid email or password
nodes.quote: REQ-AUTH-1: A wrong email or password shows the message "Invalid email or password".

nodes.label: Students cannot open the student list
nodes.quote: REQ-AUTH-2: Students cannot open the student list page.

nodes.label: Student name 2 to 50 characters
nodes.quote: REQ-STU-1: A student name must be 2 to 50 characters long.

nodes.label: Student age 5 to 18
nodes.quote: REQ-STU-2: A student must be 5 to 18 years old.

nodes.label: Unique student email
nodes.quote: REQ-STU-3: Each student email must be unique; adding a second student with the same email shows "Email already in use".

nodes.label: Student list sorted by name
nodes.quote: REQ-STU-4: The student list is sorted by name from A to Z.

nodes.label: Editing uses the same validation as adding
nodes.quote: REQ-STU-5: Editing a student applies the same validation rules as adding one.

nodes.label: Only administrators delete students
nodes.quote: REQ-STU-6: Only administrators can delete a student.

nodes.label: Class cannot exceed capacity
nodes.quote: REQ-ENR-1: A class cannot have more students than its capacity.

nodes.label: Full class shows Class is full
nodes.quote: REQ-ENR-2: Enrolling a student in a full class shows the message "Class is full".

nodes.label: No duplicate enrolment
nodes.quote: REQ-ENR-3: A student cannot be enrolled in the same class twice.

nodes.label: Grade whole number 0 to 100
nodes.quote: REQ-GRD-1: A grade must be a whole number from 0 to 100.

nodes.label: Letter grade mapping
aliases: Letter grades A B C D F
nodes.quote: REQ-GRD-2: Letter grades are A for 90 to 100, B for 80 to 89, C for 70 to 79, D for 60 to 69 and F below 60.

nodes.label: Only the class teacher enters grades
nodes.quote: REQ-GRD-3: Only the teacher of a class can enter grades for that class.

nodes.label: Class average with one decimal place
nodes.quote: REQ-GRD-4: The class average grade is shown with one decimal place.

nodes.label: No attendance for a future date
nodes.quote: REQ-ATT-1: Attendance cannot be marked for a future date.

nodes.label: Attendance rate counts Present and Late
nodes.quote: REQ-ATT-2: The attendance rate is the number of Present and Late days divided by all marked days, shown as a whole percentage.

nodes.label: Emailing parents sends one message
nodes.quote: REQ-MSG-1: Emailing parents sends one message to the parent email of that student.

nodes.label: Password reset requires a CAPTCHA
nodes.quote: REQ-PWD-1: The password reset page asks the user to solve a CAPTCHA before a reset link is sent.
